conventions.units: model pixels (1/16 block) before vanilla's 15/16 player scale
conventions.axes: +x wearer's right, +y up, +z behind the wearer; origin between the feet; wearer faces -z
conventions.rotation: degrees, applied as R = Rz @ Ry @ Rx about the bone pivot (Minecraft ModelPart order)
conventions.attach: every bone follows the player's body part (pivot at the neck, 0,24,0)
conventions.rest_pose: folded; poses are local deltas added to rest, translations in the bone's parent frame
